name: acs-electron
//workspaces: desktopapp is excluded so it installs standalone (own node_modules + package-lock.json) and `npm install` / `npm run dev` work from inside its folder. It also has outputFileTracingRoot pinned in its next.config.ts so Next doesn't walk up to this lockfile.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=packages/frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run dev --workspace=packages/app"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build --workspace=packages/frontend && npm run copy-frontend && npm run dist:win --workspace=packages/app
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build --workspace=packages/frontend && npm run copy-frontend && npm run dist:mac --workspace=packages/app
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build --workspace=packages/frontend && npm run copy-frontend && npm run dist:linux --workspace=packages/app
